convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load NRTR_extr custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic (position open/close, money management). Custom indicator buffers require understanding of NRTR_extr internals.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: NRTR_extr buffer 0 (Up trend line) non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE triggers SELL_Close when SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are both true
NRTR_extr buffer 1 (Dn trend line) non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE triggers BUY_Close when BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are both true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects between: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of loss-free margin, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of loss-balance. When MMMode=LOT, MM value is interpreted as fixed lots; otherwise MM is a fraction (e.g. 0.1 = 10%) of the selected margin base.

custom_logic_notes: Signal bar index is configurable (SignalBar input, default=1 meaning previous completed bar). The EA reads 4 buffers from NRTR_extr: buffer 0=Up trend line, buffer 1=Dn trend line, buffer 2=Up signal, buffer 3=Dn signal. Close signals have a two-tier system: primary close from signal buffers (2/3) fires unconditionally when the opposite signal appears; secondary close from trend buffers (0/1) only fires when both the open and close flags for that direction are enabled (e.g. BuyPosOpen && BuyPosClose). The Recount static flag ensures signal is re-read if CopyBuffer fails. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen and likely used for expiration or bar-identification logic inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh. GlobalVariableDel_ in OnDeinit cleans up global variables used by the trade library.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate NRTR_extr indicator logic in Python (reverse-engineer from NRTR_extr.mq5 source) or pre-compute indicator values and feed them as a data series. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh money management logic (5 modes: LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) must be reimplemented. The position open/close functions likely contain retry logic, global variable management, and position identification by signal time - all need careful translation. Signal time (SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec) is used as a trade identifier, not for pending orders. The configurable SignalBar (default 1) means signals are read from the previous completed bar, avoiding repainting. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are likely in points not pips - verify whether 5-digit adjustment is needed based on symbol digits.
